keyMappings:
map l enterInsertMode

map a scrollDown
map e scrollUp
map i scrollRight

map I goForward

map E nextTab
map A previousTab

map d removeTab
map u restoreTab
map DD closeOtherTabs
map D< closeTabsOnLeft
map D> closeTabsOnRight
